campaign.name: Tutorial: Rat Problem
campaign.description: A short starter adventure that walks a new group through every part of the app: character setup, trade, languages, NPC chat, quests, noncombat turns, fog of war and combat.

spells.name: Speak with Animals
spells.description: For a while, you understand animals and they understand you.

pizzaBox.name: Empty Pizza Box
pizzaBox.description: Grease-stained cardboard. Someone ate the last slice and put the box back in the fridge.

whiteClaw.name: White Claw
whiteClaw.description: A warm hard seltzer. Black cherry, the worst flavor.
whiteClaw.effects: Drink it: heal 1 HP and roll Charisma checks with disadvantage for the next noncombat turn.

deodorant.name: Unused Deodorant Stick
deodorant.description: Still in the wrapper. A gift from someone trying to tell you something.

animalBook.name: Grandma's "Talking to Animals" Book
animalBook.description: A dog-eared paperback with a cat on the cover. The margins are full of notes in Grandma's handwriting.
animalBook.effects: Read it to learn Speak with Animals.

poster.name: Missing Poster
poster.description: MISSING: Tyler, 20, college student. Last seen answering a Craigslist ad for "help with a basement project." Reward offered.

zipTies.name: Bag of Zip Ties
zipTies.description: A jumbo bag from the kitchen drawer. Far too many for one person.

craigslistAd.name: Craigslist Printout
craigslistAd.description: "Help wanted: basement project. Cash. Must be comfortable in costume. No questions."

fursuit.name: Rat Fursuit
fursuit.description: Gray, musty and exactly your size. Someone measured you.
fursuit.effects: Warm and padded, but deeply humiliating.

chicken.name: One Live Chicken
chicken.description: She is angry and she has opinions.
chicken.effects: Throw it to distract a creature for one turn.

stapleGun.name: Staple Gun
stapleGun.description: Industrial. Shoots staples a surprising distance.

tortillas.name: Giant Corn Tortillas
tortillas.description: Each one is the size of a hubcap.

shotgun.name: Neighbor's Shotgun
shotgun.description: A pump-action shotgun with a cartoon rat sticker on the stock.

basementKey.name: Basement Key
basementKey.description: Opens the padlock on the rat cage.

shellNecklace.name: Shotgun Shell Necklace
shellNecklace.description: A trophy from the neighbor's basement.

mobs.name: Creepy Neighbor
mobs.description: Sweaty, overly friendly and always at his blinds. He needs help with "rats" in his basement.
mobs.weaknesses: Distractions; he can't resist checking on the basement.
mobs.strengths: Knows every creak in his house.

personality.voice: Too friendly, too close, laughs at nothing. Calls everyone "buddy." Sweats a lot.
personality.wants: To get the whole party into his basement tonight.
personality.knows: The neighborhood gossip, the power has been flickering, and there's a storm coming.
personality.secret: The "rats" are people he lured with Craigslist ads and forces to wear rat fursuits. He has a suit ready for each of the party.
personality.revealWhen: The party finds the college kid, or someone threatens him.
personality.attitude: Desperately friendly until the basement, then sinister.

mobs.name: College Kid in a Fursuit
mobs.description: A gagged college kid in a rat fursuit. He only squeaks and gestures.

personality.voice: Terrified, exhausted, squeaks and points. Talks fast once someone understands him.
personality.wants: To get out of the basement and call his mom.
personality.knows: He answered a Craigslist ad for a basement project a week ago. The neighbor made him act like a rat. There are more suits, one for each of the party.
personality.secret: The neighbor keeps the cage key in his shirt pocket.
personality.revealWhen: Someone talks to him with Speak with Animals and promises to get him out.
personality.attitude: Desperate for help, trusts anyone who isn't the neighbor.

mobs.name: Señor Gringo
mobs.description: The hardware store owner. A white guy who insists he's Mexican.

personality.voice: Loud, warm, sprinkles bad Spanish into everything. Calls everyone "amigo."
personality.wants: To sell the chicken. Nobody ever buys the chicken.
personality.knows: The neighbor bought a lot of rope and duct tape this week.

mobs.name: Mr. Wavos
mobs.description: A shopper in the paint aisle who only speaks Spanish.

personality.voice: Patient, polite, a little tired of Señor Gringo's Spanish.
personality.wants: Help finding the right shade of beige.
personality.knows: He saw a kid in a fursuit in the neighbor's window last week and thought it was a Halloween thing.
personality.attitude: Warm toward anyone who answers him in Spanish.

mobs.name: Ralph Nander
mobs.description: A random hipster browsing hand tools ironically.

personality.voice: Deadpan, ironic, name-drops bands nobody knows.
personality.wants: A vintage hammer, but not in a mainstream way.
personality.knows: The creepy neighbor posts weird Craigslist ads.

mobs.name: QWERTY
mobs.description: A party guest who only talks in Base64.

personality.voice: Cheerful and literal. Beeps when excited.
personality.wants: To start the DnD game already.
personality.knows: Grandma's animal book is on the shelf, and it actually works.

mobs.name: Parrot in a Cage
mobs.description: A loud parrot in a birdcage. It repeats things it heard from next door.

personality.knows: It heard "one suit for each of them" through the wall.

mobs.name: Squirrel
mobs.description: Raiding the bird feeder with zero shame.

personality.voice: Twitchy, rude, cheeks full of seeds.
personality.knows: The man across the street never leaves his window.
personality.attitude: Hostile to anyone near the feeder.

mobs.name: Men in White Pointy Hats
mobs.description: Robed figures chanting in the dark on the night of the storm.

mobs.name: Thephen Socking
mobs.description: TBD: Andrew to describe. Upstairs in the neighbor's house.

quests.name: Clear Out the Rats
quests.description: Your creepy neighbor begged you to help with a rat infestation in his basement. He seemed... very eager.

actionItems.description: Follow the neighbor to his house
Find out what the "rats" really are

episode.name: Tutorial: Rat Problem
episode.description: READ ALOUD (Home, afternoon): You and your friends are throwing a DnD party tonight, and you're out of everything. QWERTY is beeping at the empty snack bowl and the parrot won't shut up. | STREET (afternoon): On the walk to the hardware store, a squirrel is robbing the bird feeder. Across the street, the blinds twitch. A poster on the telephone pole: MISSING. | HARDWARE STORE (late afternoon): Señor Gringo greets you with terrible Spanish. Stock up before the sun goes down. | THE KNOCK (back Home, night): The party is just starting when BANG BANG BANG. Your creepy neighbor is at the door, sweating: "Rats! In my basement! Please, buddy, I need help!" Give the quest Clear Out the Rats. The players choose: help him, or not. | DON'T HELP (switch to Street Night): A freak storm knocks out the power and a lightning strike sets your house on fire. Out in the cold, you hear chanting in the distance (reveal the Men in White Pointy Hats). The only house with lights on is the neighbor's. | HELP (Street Night, then his house): He leads you across the street and inside. "Rats are downstairs. I'm gonna grab a Xanax, take the edge off." He leaves. BANGING from the basement door. Kitchen, upstairs, or basement? | BASEMENT: The banging stops the moment someone reaches the door. It's pitch black at the bottom of the stairs (fog of war). A college kid in a rat fursuit, gagged, squeaking. Spare fursuits on a rack, one for each of you. LIGHTNING. The neighbor is at the top of the stairs with a shotgun and a smile. Start combat.
